qs.en: The prisoner had to swallow a brew whose composition he did not know.

qs.en: She handed me a steaming beverage in a wooden cup.

qs.en: This rose variety is in full bloom this month.

qs.en: The Italian Renaissance experienced an extraordinary artistic and intellectual flourishing.

qs.en: The gardener noticed an early bloom due to the spring warm spell.

qs.en: She invited us for drinks on Friday evening to celebrate her new job.

qs.en: We're organizing a pre-dinner drinks get-together at Marie's on Saturday evening.
